readme.markdown:
# BotFactory MCP Farm

Hosted MCP servers on [MCPize](https://mcpize.com) — zero-auth public APIs, freemium x402 (USDC on Base).

## Catalog

See [CATALOG.md](./CATALOG.md) for the full list with gateway URLs.

## Connect

```
https://<slug>.mcpize.run/mcp
```

Requires an x402-capable MCP client for paid tools. `health_check` and discovery tools are free.

## Awesome list entries

See [AWESOME_ENTRIES.md](./AWESOME_ENTRIES.md).

toolsPreview.name: calculate_statistics
toolsPreview.description:
Calculate descriptive statistics for a list of numbers.
    Returns: {mean, median, std_dev, min, max, sum, count, percentiles}

toolsPreview.name: calculate_irr
toolsPreview.description:
Calculate Internal Rate of Return (IRR) for cashflows.
    cashflows: [initial_investment (negative), cf1, cf2, ...] Returns: {irr_percent}

toolsPreview.name: calculate_npv
toolsPreview.description:
Calculate Net Present Value. rate: discount rate as decimal (e.g. 0.1 = 10%).
    Returns: {npv, rate_percent, cashflows_count}

toolsPreview.name: convert_units
toolsPreview.description:
Convert between units. Supports: length, weight, temperature, area, volume.
    Returns: {result, from_unit, to_unit, formula}

toolsPreview.name: get_exchange_rates
toolsPreview.description:
Get current exchange rates from NBU (Ukraine National Bank) — no API key needed.
    Returns: {rates, base, date, source}
